title: HubSpot, store orders and Wix blogs
content:
# HubSpot, store orders and Wix blogs Sync your inbox to HubSpot, read Shopify and WooCommerce orders in one format, publish to Wix, and four new Instagram endpoints. This week Zernio reached three tools your customers already live in: their CRM, their store and their blog. **In short:** - Inbox conversations now land on HubSpot contacts, with no glue code. - Shopify and WooCommerce orders come back in one shape, ready for invoicing. - Wix joins the Blogs API, so one integration publishes to three blog platforms. **Organic Reddit is temporarily unavailable.** Reddit blocked third-party API access on October 19, so organic Reddit endpoints answer `503` with `PLATFORM_DISABLED` until it is restored. Reddit Ads keeps working. ## Your inbox, inside HubSpot If your customers sell with HubSpot, they no longer copy chats into it by hand. Connect their portal to a profile and every conversation lands on the right contact. WhatsApp and SMS arrive as communications, the rest as notes. Contacts are matched by email, then phone, and created when missing. ```bash curl "https://zernio.com/api/v1/connect/hubspot?profileId=PROFILE_ID" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $ZERNIO_API_KEY" # → { "authUrl": "https://app.hubspot.com/oauth/authorize?...", "state": "..." } ``` Send your user to `authUrl` and that's it. To keep contacts in sync but stop logging messages, switch that part off: ```bash curl -X PATCH "https://zernio.com/api/v1/accounts/ACCOUNT_ID/hubspot-settings" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $ZERNIO_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "logMessages": false }' ``` Workflows can write to HubSpot too. A typical use: a WhatsApp bot asks for an email, then saves the lead. The `hubspot_upsert_contact` step only writes the fields you set: ```json { "id": "push-lead", "type": "hubspot_upsert_contact", "config": { "email": "{{answer}}", "properties": { "lifecyclestage": "lead" } } } ``` **Learn more:** [HubSpot setup](/platforms/hubspot) · [What gets synced](/platforms/hubspot/sync) · [Workflows](/products/automations/workflows) ## One order format for every store Building an accounting, analytics or fulfilment tool? Shopify and WooCommerce orders now come back in the same shape: line items with unit prices, tax per line, discounts, shipping, billing details, payment status and refunds. That is enough to rebuild an invoice without knowing which store it came from. ```bash curl "https://zernio.com/api/v1/commerce/orders?accountId=ACCOUNT_ID&updatedAfter=2026-10-01T00:00:00Z" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $ZERNIO_API_KEY" ``` ```json { "orders": [ { "id": "6148123456", "platform": "shopify", "number": "#1001", "currency": "EUR", "total": { "amount": "210.00", "currency": "EUR" }, "taxTotal": { "amount": "36.45", "currency": "EUR" }, "paymentStatus": "paid" } ], "nextCursor": null } ``` To stay in sync without polling, subscribe a webhook to `commerce.order.created`, `commerce.order.updated` and `commerce.order.refunded`, then fetch the full order by id. **Learn more:** [Commerce guide](/guides/commerce) · [List orders](/commerce/list-commerce-orders) · [Get an order](/commerce/get-commerce-order) ## Publish to Wix blogs If your product writes blog posts for small businesses, many of them run on Wix. Wix now works exactly like Shopify and WordPress. Connect a site, then create, schedule or edit posts with the same calls. ```bash curl -X POST "https://zernio.com/api/v1/accounts/ACCOUNT_ID/blogs/1/articles" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $ZERNIO_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "title": "Spring menu is here", "bodyHtml": "

Five new dishes from our kitchen.

", "publishDate": "2030-03-01T09:00:00Z" }' ``` A future `publishDate` schedules the post on Wix itself, so it goes out even if your servers are down. Leave it out to publish now. **Learn more:** [Connect Wix](/platforms/wix/connect) · [Wix articles](/platforms/wix/articles) · [Create an article](/blogs/create-blog-article) ## Four things Instagram users asked for All four need an Instagram account connected with Facebook Login. - **Who's live right now:** list the account's live broadcasts, to moderate or reply to live comments. - **Where it was tagged:** the posts other accounts tagged it in, newest first. Useful for UGC and creator tracking. - **Collab posts:** who was invited on a post and who accepted. - **Posts and stickers in DMs:** reply with one of the account's own posts instead of a link. ```bash curl -X POST "https://zernio.com/api/v1/inbox/conversations/CONVERSATION_ID/messages" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $ZERNIO_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "accountId": "ACCOUNT_ID", "sharedMediaId": "17895695668004550" }' ``` **Learn more:** [Live media](/instagram/list-instagram-live-media) · [Tagged posts](/instagram/list-instagram-tagged-media) · [Collaborators](/instagram/list-instagram-media-collaborators) · [Instagram inbox](/platforms/instagram/inbox) ## Post history that stays fast If you sync a large post history, deep pages used to get slower. `GET /v1/posts` now pages with a cursor, so page 500 costs the same as page 1. It also returns only the fields you ask for: ```bash curl "https://zernio.com/api/v1/posts?limit=100&fields=status,scheduledFor,platforms" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $ZERNIO_API_KEY" # Next page: pass pagination.nextCursor back as cursor=... ``` **Learn more:** [List posts](/posts/list-posts) ## Also this week - **Webflow blogs:** publish to Webflow CMS collections, connected with a site token. [Webflow setup](/platforms/webflow) - **Branded connect, set once:** save your welcome screen for the whole workspace instead of passing it on every link. [Welcome screen settings](/connect/update-connect-welcome-screen) - **Ads:** invite users to Google Ads accounts, see why a TikTok Smart+ ad was rejected, get interest ideas for Meta targeting, and edit Meta ad set placements. - **Conversions in chats:** Meta can now credit sales that happen inside WhatsApp, Messenger or Instagram DMs. - **Analytics:** LinkedIn follower demographics, more Google Business search keywords, and how long each account must wait between posts. - **Posts:** tag up to 10 people on X photos. - **Inbox:** filter conversations to SMS only. - **Worth handling:** WhatsApp username endpoints and SMS registrations can now answer `403` when permission is missing. Want every detail? See [every change, day by day](/changelog?view=all).
